rationale: The papers on infrared spectroscopy and optical spectroscopy of Be stars provide insights into the circumstellar envelope's properties and dynamics, contributing evidence relevant to the origin of the gaseous disk envelope surrounding Be stars. The study on disk tearing and precession also explores the variability of Be stars, which relates to the envelope's characteristics.
